notes.title: v1.3.0 New Character
notes.content:
v1.3.0
New Character: Ducher
A mysterious hunter roaming the jungle, moving silently and striking with unerring accuracy.
A ranged shooter specializing in attacking enemies from a distance.
Added exclusive gems for this character.
Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where character animations displayed incorrectly after taking damage.

notes.title: V1.2.0 Update Abyss Challenge
notes.content:
v1.2.0
Introducing new difficulty: Abyss
---Monsters with abyssal difficulty will have abyssal buffs
---Abyss difficulty can increase the number of layers for challenges
---Abyssal difficulty will bring richer rewards

Significantly increased the tickets reward after complete the game

Bug fixes:
1. Fix the error in the Max level description of the KittyDucky's skill 3 range branch.
2. Update the English name of the GloryFlag to RadientFlag.
3. Issue of incorrect quality and color of gemstone information modification

notes.title: Duck Duck Adventure is Now Available!
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm! We are thrilled to announce that Duck Duck Adventure has officially been released, along with the following upcoming update plans to make your gaming experience even more diverse and exciting:

Brand New Heroes Every month, we will introduce a new hero with unique skills and charm, offering you more choices and delightful surprises for your strategic lineup!

Expanded Card Factions In future updates, we will add two entirely new card factions to diversify your battle strategies even further!

New Game Mode A brand new game mode will be rolled out soon, bringing fresh challenges and fun—get ready to experience a whole new style of combat!

Additional Game Difficulties To cater to different player preferences, we will introduce more difficulty options, challenging you to push your limits and achieve even greater triumphs!

New Store Talents Our store system will also be enhanced with a variety of new talents, providing you with unexpected advantages and surprises throughout your adventure!

We remain committed to listening to your feedback and continuously optimizing and updating our content, striving to create an even more exciting and dynamic world in Duck Duck Adventure! Stay tuned for every update, and feel free to share your valuable suggestions as we work together to craft this masterpiece!

Thank you once again for your support and attention—join us and embark on a brand new adventure!
